verdict.rationale: Bulk or batch processing is a fair question for a URL-to-markdown API, but the evidence documents only single-URL requests to r.jina.ai and single file POSTs. The search endpoint fetching its top 5 results is an internal behavior of a different feature, not a user-driven bulk operation over many chosen items. No batch endpoint or multi-URL request capability is evidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
